## Description

Restyle /trust to the 6 Nov design: "Patient data is the most personal data there is. We treat it that way.", the control cards and "Compliance status · updated by Medvya · not a certification". Policy versions and sub-processors keep coming from PublicSite/trust-centre.json. The demo form moves to /demo (MDV-P1-057).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the trust centre, when it renders, then the compliance block says it is not a certification and every status comes from trust-centre.json.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given JavaScript is off, when the page loads, then it renders fully; axe is clean in en, hi and ar; Arabic is right to left.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
